newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total seen posting big 1996 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Total seen posting big 1996 profit rise.

text.p: French oil group Total SA is expected to report a jump of at least 45 percent in 1996 earnings per share to 23.30 francs, against 15.80 francs in 1995, when it reveals its results on Wednesday morning
A poll of 23 analysts by Jacques Chahine Finance, concluded on January 24, shows a forecast range of between 21.10 francs and 29 francs per share.
The 1995 results, at 2.25 billion francs, were depressed by 1.5 billion francs in special write-offs.
The 1996 earnings are expected to be boosted by the exploration and production side even though further write-downs for the disused Norway offshore Frigg platform are expected.
